Professional Summary
Data analyst with strong expertise in transforming business requirements into actionable insights using SQL, Looker, Power BI and Excel. Proven track record delivering dashboards, reports and ad-hoc analyses to improve product metrics and operational efficiency. Open to relocation anywhere in India. Notice period: 90 days.

SQL, Python, Power BI, Microsoft Excel, Looker, Git, Jira

- Partnered with product and growth teams via Jira workflows and Git-tracked analysis notebooks to prioritize experiments, delivering clear metric definitions and cohort tables in Microsoft Excel for stakeholder review.

- Collaborated with cross-functional teams using Jira and Git for version control of analysis artifacts, producing ad-hoc analyses and executive summaries from Looker delivers and Excel pivot modeling.
